name: repurpose
description: Turn one source into a LinkedIn post draft and an Instagram carousel plan that share one confirmed message, then hand each to its channel plugin.

interface.shortDescription: 글 하나로 LinkedIn 글과 인스타 캐러셀을 함께
interface.longDescription: Find one confirmed message in a topic, notes, or a file, save it as a brief, and draft a LinkedIn post and an Instagram carousel plan from it through the linkedin-post and instagram-carousel plugins. Never publishes or exports by itself.
